title: Playwright End-to-End Testing
description: Playwright reference covering configuration, locators, assertions, fixtures, isolation, authentication, network control, downloads, frames, parallelism, retries, traces, CI, accessibility, and reliable test design.

subtopics.title: Configuration & Browser Projects
subtopics.description: Centralize baseURL, timeouts, traces, webServer, and browser/device projects. Keep environment differences explicit and reproducible.

subtopics.title: User-Facing Locators & Auto-Waiting
subtopics.description: Prefer role, label, placeholder, text, and stable test ID locators. Locators re-resolve and actions/assertions auto-wait for actionability.

callouts.title: Never Add Fixed Sleeps
callouts.text: waitForTimeout hides races and slows suites. Wait for a user-visible state, response, URL, event, or domain-specific condition.

subtopics.title: Fixtures & Page Objects
subtopics.description: Fixtures own setup/teardown and dependencies. Page objects should expose user intent, not reproduce every DOM node.

subtopics.title: Authentication & Test Data
subtopics.description: Reuse authenticated storage state without sharing mutable test data. Give parallel workers unique accounts/records and clean up through owned APIs.

callouts.title: Tests Must Be Independently Repeatable
callouts.text: Do not depend on execution order, another test's data, or a shared mutable account.

subtopics.title: Request Routing, Responses & API Setup
subtopics.description: Intercept narrowly, fulfill deterministic edge cases, inspect outbound contracts, and use APIRequestContext for setup when UI setup is not under test.

subtopics.title: Popups, Downloads, Frames & Visual Checks
subtopics.description: Register event waits before triggering actions; use frameLocator for iframes; stabilize fonts/data/animation before screenshots.

subtopics.title: Traces, Retries, Sharding & Flakes
subtopics.description: Use traces/screenshots/video as failure artifacts, treat retry success as flakiness debt, and shard only after tests are isolated.

codeBlocks.code:
npx playwright test --trace on
npx playwright show-trace test-results/**/trace.zip
npx playwright test --shard=1/4

subtopics.title: Setup Projects, Clock & Test Steps
subtopics.description: Use dependency projects to create authenticated states or shared prerequisites, Clock to control time-dependent behavior, and test.step to make domain actions visible in reports and traces.

callouts.title: Keep Setup State Non-Secret
callouts.text: Storage-state files can contain session credentials. Keep them out of source control and artifacts, scope test identities narrowly, and expire or revoke them after runs.

subtopics.title: Accessibility & Suite Checklist
subtopics.description: Assert user outcomes and semantics, keep a small critical E2E layer, move pure logic down the test stack, and track duration/flakiness.

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Use semantic locators, web-first assertions, isolated data, no fixed sleeps, bounded timeouts, traces on retry, pinned browsers, CI artifacts, accessibility checks, and quarantine with owners—not silence.
